column1: # Shortcuts GIMPhoto has moved from one command to another. A profile with
# its own shortcutsrc (anyone who has run GIMPhoto) keeps its saved
# shortcuts over GIMPhoto's defaults, so each move here is applied to it
# once, when it still has the old shortcut on the old command (patch
# "Default shortcut updates reach existing profiles"). tools/make_keymap.py
# writes them into defaults/shortcutsrc; add a line, with a higher version,
# whenever photoshop-keymap.tsv moves a shortcut that was there before.
# version <TAB> shortcut <TAB> old action <TAB> new action
